name: @cloudsforge/tessera
description: Tessera: a persistent isometric world. Wards, parcels claimed free and reclaimed by a fallow clock, objects fired from a prompt, and EMBER earned rather than only spent.
_runtimeDependencies: The @cloudsforge/* runtime and contract packages are consumed as file:/link: paths into the
sibling repositories because they are not published yet. Once AD-02 lands they become registry
versions and these paths — plus the two named build contexts in the Dockerfile — are deleted.
tsx is a runtime dependency for the same reason: the unpublished packages resolve to their
_citationPins: @cloudsforge/ui is a devDependency for TESTS ONLY, and only its `./cite` subpath — a content-pin
helper over node:fs used by src/citations.test.ts. The package has NO runtime dependencies
(react and react-dom are peer deps the cite subpath never touches) and dist/cite.js is committed,
so this pulls in no tree and needs no build step. It is linked rather than reimplemented here
because a second copy of a citation checker in a second repository is the exact defect
studioclient.ts complains about: two spellings of one brief, with nothing comparing them.
